description:
## Return YouTube Username v2.2.9

- Support Video Title & Description Mentions: Replaces channel handle mentions (@handle) in video titles and description boxes with the actual channel name (@ChannelName), keeping the '@' symbol.
- Refined Subtitle Spacing: Changed spacing between channel name and view count under the video to a clean single space.
- Dedicated Setting: Added '替換影片標題與說明欄提及' switch under Morphe settings.
- Pure Standalone Morphe Patch Bundle (~21 KB): Fully compatible with Morphe 2.1.0+ and YouTube 21.30.216.
